title: The hypothalamus helps keep body conditions in balance through nerves and hormones
summary: OpenStax says the hypothalamus coordinates internal balance through the autonomic nervous system and hormones.
body: OpenStax says the hypothalamus coordinates homeostatic functions through the autonomic and endocrine systems. Homeostasis, in that book's terms, means keeping internal conditions in balance. The autonomic system is the part a person does not consciously direct, and the endocrine system works by hormones. The chapter places the hypothalamus in the diencephalon, beside the thalamus, which it calls a relay. This card is that balance job. Region names for the cerebrum and cerebellum are a different card.

sources.title: 13.2 The Central Nervous System, chapter review
sources.author: OpenStax
sources.note: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology, first edition, web view, CC BY 4.0. Paraphrase: the hypothalamus coordinates homeostatic functions through the autonomic and endocrine systems. The thalamus-as-relay sentence is context, not a second claim.
